---
title: I have data that updates regularly, can I deposit it with the Faculty Research Data Collection? 
categories: [Faculty Research Data, Deposit]
---

The Faculty Research Data Collection is not designed to support continuously updated data, as all datasets must go through a manual curation and review process. Please reach out to [librarydataservices@berkeley.edu](mailto:librarydataservices@berkeley.edu) if you would like to discuss depositing snapshots of dynamic data.
